summary: This is a Git configuration file setting up core behavior. It disables automatic line-ending conversion, meaning Git won't try to convert between Windows-style (CRLF) and Unix-style (LF) line endings on this repository.

explanations.2: The 'autocrlf = false' setting tells Git not to automatically convert line endings when you commit or check out files. This is useful when you want to preserve exactly the line endings that are in your files without Git messing with them.
